description: This file defines the WorkspaceAssociationInterface, an interface for managing workspace-entity associations in Drupal, including methods for tracking entities, retrieving associated revisions, and workspace initialization.

classes.name: WorkspaceAssociationInterface
classes.description: Interface for workspace-entity association management in Drupal.

methods.name: trackEntity
methods.description: Updates or creates the association for a given entity and a workspace.

methods.name: workspaceInsert
methods.description: Responds to the creation of a new workspace entity.

methods.name: getTrackedEntities
methods.description: Retrieves entities tracked by a specific workspace, optionally filtered by entity type and IDs.

methods.name: getTrackedEntitiesForListing
methods.description: Retrieves a paged list of entities tracked by a workspace.

methods.name: getAssociatedRevisions
methods.description: Retrieves all revisions associated with a workspace for a specific entity type.

methods.name: getAssociatedInitialRevisions
methods.description: Retrieves all revisions created in a workspace for a specific entity type.

methods.name: getEntityTrackingWorkspaceIds
methods.description: Gets list of workspace IDs where an entity is tracked.

methods.name: deleteAssociations
methods.description: Deletes workspace association records based on provided filters.

methods.name: initializeWorkspace
methods.description: Initializes a workspace with associations from its parent.
